summary: Frontend-only regression of the modern UI restructure across all 11 calculator modules + Catalog/Quotes click-through. Login as admin/admin123 OK, dashboard + full sidebar (Paper Printing, Booklet, Large Format, Stickers, DTF, Embroidery, Laser, Direct Print, Channel Letters, Sublimation, Roll Stickers, Price Catalog, My Quotes, Equipment, Users, Settings). Every calc button rendered its results container: paper-results (4 paper-compare-row, side-4_0/side-4_4 toggle works, clicking compare row #2 re-selects it), booklet-results, sticker-results (3 sticker-compare-row), lf-results (4 lf-compare-row), laser-results (2 laser-compare-row), dp-results (3 dp-compare-row), cl-results (2 cl-compare-row), dtf-results, embroidery-results, sub-results, rs-results. Save Quote from /paper succeeded via save-quote-button -> quote-customer -> quote-save-confirm. Catalog: 8 catalog-row entries; clicking a row opened quote-detail-dialog with Specifications + Cost & Pricing + Quoted Price header. Quotes: 9 quote-row entries; clicking row cells opened quote-detail-dialog with full data; email-quote button opened only the email dialog (no detail dialog — stopPropagation confirmed); delete-quote removed the TEST_Customer row without opening the detail dialog and rowcount went 9 -> 8.
critical_code_review_comments: priceOf() helper is duplicated in three files (Catalog.js, Quotes.js, components/Metric.js) with 8+ fallback keys each — consolidate into a single import from Metric.js (already exported) and delete the local copies.

QuoteDetailDialog.flatten() blindly walks summary sub-objects to depth 2 and prints every scalar; some module summaries include internal fields (e.g. Created At ISO strings, Retail Markup Pct = 0) that look messy in the Specifications table — consider a per-module allow-list or richer label mapping.

PaperPrinting.js still defines its own local <Metric> component instead of importing the shared one from components/Metric.js — same visual result but a DRY drift risk when the shared Metric is later restyled.

SaveQuote dialog button labeled 'Save quote' uses testid quote-save-confirm while the trigger uses save-quote-button — inconsistent prefix (quote- vs save-quote-). Not a functional bug but naming should be normalized.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (11/11 calculators + save-quote + catalog dialog + quote dialog + stopPropagation on email/delete)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one transient quote 'TEST_Customer_<epoch>' from /paper — cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All modern-UI testids from review request are wired correctly. Login button has no type=submit, use get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'). paper-compare-row/sticker-compare-row/lf-compare-row/laser-compare-row/dp-compare-row/cl-compare-row are all present. Catalog row click and Quotes row click open the SAME QuoteDetailDialog (testid quote-detail-dialog). email-quote and delete-quote buttons in Quotes.js use onClick={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()} on the parent <td> which correctly prevents opening the detail dialog. Existing seed data in the shared preview DB includes enough saved quotes (7-8 catalog products, 8-9 quote rows) that no additional seeding is needed.
